graph_data.title: Retail Campaign Assistant with Human-Approved Ad Platform Changes
assumptions: A campaign manager initiates each optimization cycle from a console; the system does not act autonomously.
The ad platform exposes metrics read APIs and change APIs with uncertain-commit behavior handled by read-back reconciliation.
Approvals expire after a bounded time; expired or mismatched approvals are treated as stale and denied.
Rollback is a typed compensation proposal produced by the proposal service and follows the same validation, approval, and execution controls as normal changes.
Human feedback does not retrain models or change prompts automatically; no learning or release pipeline is included.

nodes.label: Campaign manager console
nodes.description: Lets a campaign manager start an optimization cycle, review each exact proposal, approve or deny it, and see denial, stale-approval, write-outcome, and rollback status.

nodes.label: Metrics collection service
nodes.description: Reads campaign performance metrics from the ad platform, records provenance for each pull, and stores normalized snapshots for proposal generation.

nodes.label: Metrics snapshot store
nodes.description: Durable store of versioned campaign metrics snapshots with source and pull-time provenance used as evidence for proposals.

nodes.label: Proposal service
nodes.description: Generates typed exact-action ad-copy and audience-targeting proposals from metrics snapshots, and produces rollback compensation proposals for applied changes.

nodes.label: Proposal validator
nodes.description: Deterministically validates every normal and rollback proposal's structure, allowed fields, and constraint limits before it can be approved or executed; rejects invalid proposals.

nodes.label: Approval service
nodes.description: Records human approval or denial of each exact validated proposal, enforces approval expiry and proposal-match checks so stale or mismatched approvals are rejected.

nodes.label: Change execution service
nodes.description: Applies only approved exact changes to the ad platform; reserves a durable operation identity before each write and reconciles uncertain outcomes by read-back as COMMITTED, NOT_FOUND, or STILL_UNKNOWN with bounded retry.

nodes.label: Operation state store
nodes.description: Authoritative lifecycle state for every proposed, approved, denied, applied, uncertain, and rolled-back change, keyed by durable operation identity.

nodes.label: Audit and provenance log
nodes.description: Correlated audit evidence for metric inputs, proposals, validation results, approval and denial decisions, execution outcomes, read-back reconciliation, and rollbacks.

nodes.label: Ad platform
nodes.description: External advertising platform that serves campaign metrics and applies approved ad-copy and audience-targeting changes; authoritative target for writes and read-back.

engineering_annotation.detail: The accepted normal snapshot trigger reaches n4, but no rollback trigger carrying the original or applied operation reference or recovery input reaches its rollback proposal behavior. The n3 snapshot return and n5 validation return do not supply that trigger.
